title: Incorrect warning for case mismatch when opening certain symlinks on Linux
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in v4.6.2.stable.fedora [71f334935], 720caf4
- The warning was added in c09731c, and I think it has existed since then

### System information

Godot v4.6.2.stable (71f334935) - Fedora Linux 42 (Sway) on Wayland - Wayland display driver, Multi-window, 2 monitors - Vulkan (Mobile) - integrated Intel(R) Iris(R) Xe Graphics (ADL GT2) - 12th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-1230U (12 threads) - 7.37 GiB memory

### Issue description

When a file is stored with a symlink which only differs from its target by case, this warning will show up:

> WARNING: Case mismatch opening requested file '/tmp/dir/new-game-project/project.godot', stored as '/tmp/Dir/new-game-project/project.godot' in the filesystem. This file will not open when exported to other case-sensitive platforms.
     at: open_internal (drivers/unix/file_access_unix.cpp:116)

This is the content of the tmp directory:

> lrwxrwxrwx. 1  3 May 17 14:32 dir -> Dir
drwxr-xr-x. 3 60 May 17 14:32 Dir

This warning shouldn't appear because '/tmp/dir/new-game-project/project.godot' is a valid path to the file with the correct case.

### Steps to reproduce

Create a project in a directory which is a symlink to a directory which only differs in case.

1.  Create a directory and create a symlink for it
```bash
mkdir Dir
ln -s Dir dir
```
2. Create a project in the symlink (dir)
